name: 画像の切り抜きと関連する結果のパネル
prompt: Perform MINIMAL TEXT REPLACEMENT on this ORIGINAL screenshot crop, no reconstruction or relayout. Freeze every photographic pixel, every crop, frame handle, X, sheet geometry, drag handle, three-dot menu, and watermark EXACTLY in its original position and aspect. Replace only tab text Explore→'探索', Shop→'商品', keep Shop selected, same regular text weight and underline shape; underline may dark forest green. Replace first price $227.99→'￥2,800' and second £10.99→'￥1,500' inside same white badges. Replace first result vendor/title two lines with Japanese '花の写真のアイデア' / 'チューリップの写真'; second result vendor/title two lines with Japanese '季節の花を見つける' / '花の写真'. Use small Meiryo Regular14/24 and metadata12/16, never bold tabs. Original right photo 'Branded Garden Products Ltd' watermark MUST remain unchanged. Preserve any partly visible third-row photo at the bottom EXACTLY, no content invention and no deletion. Do not add green caption band, redesign cards or reposition any media. Do not redraw petals, texture, lighting, background, crop rectangles or corners. Original top coral tulip is dominant; keep its dimmed exterior and offset crop control pixel geometry exactly. Whole original-size composition, same aspect, Japanese localized UI only; pure white sheet remains. Exact protected media preservation required.
reviewNotes: Original-only minimal text edit retains overall geometry, crop handles/X, sheet handle, selected tab, menus, watermark and partial third row. Fine protected petal texture/crops still resynthesized and Regular tabs remain heavy; unrequested partial third price currency changed from dollar to yen. No acceptance. Both attempts retained; new effective media-preservation hypothesis needed, no repeated unchanged retries.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
